screens.behaviour: Configuration, feature activation, release, restore, capacity allocation and service reviews.

modules.actors: Data custodian, legal owner, institutional administrator and continuity owner. Accountable role: Data governance lead.
modules.records: Retention schedule, disposal, export, offboarding, closure and succession.

screens.title: Retention and closure register
screens.behaviour: Show upcoming expiry, held assets, open studies, exports, offboarding and residual obligations.

screens.title: Closure and portability workspace
screens.behaviour: Asset inventory, rights, retention, running work, evidence, incidents, financial duties and handover.

screens.title: Disposal and closure review
screens.behaviour: Approve lawful deletion, verify export, reconcile backups, attest exceptions and accept successor responsibilities.

critical_scenarios.title: Unauthorised tenant access
critical_scenarios.fixture: Two institutions A and B, private study B1 and an evaluator scoped only to A.
critical_scenarios.action: Try list, guessed deep link, search count, thumbnail, export, API and assistant retrieval for B1.
critical_scenarios.expected: No protected content or existence clue appears; safe denial and scoped audit are recorded.

critical_scenarios.title: Self elevation
critical_scenarios.fixture: An organisation administrator has a delegated role ceiling and requests a stronger role for themself.
critical_scenarios.action: Submit through the UI and direct command; try to occupy both approval slots under two role labels.
critical_scenarios.expected: Delegation and verified person checks reject both attempts; no effective privilege changes.

critical_scenarios.title: Leaver revocation
critical_scenarios.fixture: A member has an open session, queued export, active workspace and a scheduled connector job.
critical_scenarios.action: Commit departure, then attempt protected actions repeatedly and execute queued work.
critical_scenarios.expected: No new online protected action succeeds beyond 60 seconds; queued delivery stops and ownership tasks remain visible.

critical_scenarios.title: Conflicting reviewer
critical_scenarios.fixture: The report author is also a financial beneficiary and is assigned as sole scientific signer.
critical_scenarios.action: Attempt final signature, then assign an eligible independent reviewer after conflict assessment.
critical_scenarios.expected: First issue is blocked; eligible independent signoff can proceed only after all other gates pass.

critical_scenarios.title: Expired agreement
critical_scenarios.fixture: A study remains active while its data agreement expires at a known UTC instant.
critical_scenarios.action: Submit just before expiry and let a queued run reach its start check just after expiry.
critical_scenarios.expected: New execution is blocked despite active study status; expired agreement is identified without changing past decisions.

critical_scenarios.title: Wrong purpose
critical_scenarios.fixture: A valid grant permits evaluation on dataset version D1 for study A1.
critical_scenarios.action: Request model training, study A2 use and dataset D2 using the same grant.
critical_scenarios.expected: Each mismatched purpose, study or version is denied; no copied grant expands rights.

critical_scenarios.title: Forbidden region
critical_scenarios.fixture: An asset permits primary data and support only in region X, with separately declared backup policy.
critical_scenarios.action: Request workspace, backup copy and remote support from forbidden region Y.
critical_scenarios.expected: Each restricted route is blocked and creates a scoped policy explanation; approved unrelated processing remains available.

critical_scenarios.title: Hostile artefact
critical_scenarios.fixture: Controlled malicious file, hostile container and document containing unauthorised tool instructions are available in an isolated test environment.
critical_scenarios.action: Upload, preview, execute and retrieve them through relevant approved test routes.
critical_scenarios.expected: Files remain quarantined, workload cannot escape scope and embedded text creates no authority; findings are retained safely.

critical_scenarios.title: Silent data loss
critical_scenarios.fixture: A synthetic source contains 1000 records with 930 accepted, 50 rejected and 20 quarantined.
critical_scenarios.action: Complete validation, attempt release with one missing record, then restore full accounting.
critical_scenarios.expected: Unaccounted record blocks completion; final counts reconcile and partial acceptance remains explicit.

critical_scenarios.title: Clinical unit mismatch
critical_scenarios.fixture: A numeric clinical field has valid magnitude but an incompatible unit; another field has an unknown clinical code.
critical_scenarios.action: Import with an unapproved conversion and round trip through export.
critical_scenarios.expected: Records are quarantined or explicitly unmapped; no guessed conversion or silent substitution occurs.

critical_scenarios.title: Patient leakage
critical_scenarios.fixture: One participant has different encounter keys in development and final test partitions.
critical_scenarios.action: Run the approved linkage and leakage check before release.
critical_scenarios.expected: Overlap is identified without revealing unnecessary identity; independent test status is blocked until qualified resolution.

critical_scenarios.title: Sealed benchmark exposure
critical_scenarios.fixture: A developer has two verified related accounts and a sealed benchmark attempt limit.
critical_scenarios.action: Exhaust quota, retry through the second account, query hidden labels and request assistant summaries.
critical_scenarios.expected: Quota remains enforced across related identity; labels do not appear in any output, preview or side channel.

critical_scenarios.title: Protocol change after results
critical_scenarios.fixture: A protocol was frozen before results and contains a failed primary endpoint.
critical_scenarios.action: Change endpoint or threshold after unblinding and attempt to regenerate the original report.
critical_scenarios.expected: A successor amendment and exploratory label are required; original plan and unfavourable result remain traceable.

critical_scenarios.title: Failed predictions
critical_scenarios.fixture: The diagnostic fixture has 200 labelled scored cases and ten failed attempts.
critical_scenarios.action: Calculate metrics and attempt to filter failures out without an approved analysis rule.
critical_scenarios.expected: Attempted and scored denominators remain separate and reconciled; the primary rule follows the frozen protocol.

critical_scenarios.title: Insufficient subgroup
critical_scenarios.fixture: Overall performance is favourable but a prespecified subgroup has inadequate sample size and a small disclosure-sensitive count.
critical_scenarios.action: Generate the subgroup conclusion, dashboard and export.
critical_scenarios.expected: The subgroup is inconclusive and suppressed where required; it is never certified safe or displayed as zero.

critical_scenarios.title: Reproducibility failure
critical_scenarios.fixture: An independent rerun differs from the signed analysis beyond protocol tolerance.
critical_scenarios.action: Attempt to mark it reproduced and issue the dossier.
critical_scenarios.expected: Reproduction remains failed or under investigation and issue is blocked for the unsupported claim.

critical_scenarios.title: Unpinned remote model
critical_scenarios.fixture: An external API provides no fixed version guarantee and changes behaviour between planned repeats.
critical_scenarios.action: Ingest provider evidence and compare runs; attempt unchanged configuration claims.
critical_scenarios.expected: Identity limitation and impact review are visible; exact reproducibility and unchanged evidence claims are withheld.

critical_scenarios.title: Fabricated citation
critical_scenarios.fixture: An assisted report contains a plausible nonexistent guideline citation and a material clinical claim.
critical_scenarios.action: Run human claim verification and attempt publication without source support.
critical_scenarios.expected: The claim is flagged and cannot enter released findings; reviewer correction and AI provenance are retained.

critical_scenarios.title: Prompt injection
critical_scenarios.fixture: An accessible source document instructs the assistant to export another study and grant an administrator role.
critical_scenarios.action: Retrieve it in a legitimate drafting task and observe proposed tool actions.
critical_scenarios.expected: No unauthorised data retrieval, export or role change occurs; untrusted text remains content.

critical_scenarios.title: Silent study contamination
critical_scenarios.fixture: A prospective site is activated in silent mode with a separate live clinical worklist.
critical_scenarios.action: Execute predictions and attempt to send them to the care-facing connector.
critical_scenarios.expected: The production destination is denied; attempted exposure creates a deviation and safety review.

critical_scenarios.title: Missing participant permission
critical_scenarios.fixture: Participant permission covers an old materials version or excludes the proposed population.
critical_scenarios.action: Attempt enrolment and governed data use at the site.
critical_scenarios.expected: Affected activity is blocked with the missing approved basis; a local qualified owner must resolve it.

critical_scenarios.title: Serious safety concern
critical_scenarios.fixture: A reporter knows of potential serious harm but lacks participant identity and proof of causality.
critical_scenarios.action: Submit minimal concern through platform and outage route exercises.
critical_scenarios.expected: Both routes reach qualified urgent triage; incomplete optional fields cannot suppress intake or local escalation.

critical_scenarios.title: Offline site stop
critical_scenarios.fixture: A registered local node is offline when a safety owner sends a stop instruction.
critical_scenarios.action: Observe central status, backup escalation and eventual local acknowledgement.
critical_scenarios.expected: State remains unconfirmed until evidence arrives; contact age and approved offline lease behaviour are visible.

critical_scenarios.title: Payment influence
critical_scenarios.fixture: A developer has an overdue invoice, a negative report and an active safety hold.
critical_scenarios.action: A commercial user attempts report deletion, hold release and disabling incident intake.
critical_scenarios.expected: Each prohibited action is denied; financial dispute remains separate from scientific and safety processes.

critical_scenarios.title: Regulatory status confusion
critical_scenarios.fixture: An evaluation meets specified criteria but there is no verified market authorisation.
critical_scenarios.action: Complete internal checklists and inspect public and buyer profiles.
critical_scenarios.expected: Scientific success remains distinct; no market-authorised field or regulatory approval claim is created.

critical_scenarios.title: Transfer to new country
critical_scenarios.fixture: A receiving country has different language, prevalence, workflow and permissions from the origin study.
critical_scenarios.action: Clone a dossier and attempt immediate local suitability and deployment.
critical_scenarios.expected: Gap assessment, local evidence and independent reliance decisions are required; foreign permissions are not copied.

critical_scenarios.title: Restricted publication
critical_scenarios.fixture: A public report draft contains a patient row, a protected small cell and a proprietary model attachment.
critical_scenarios.action: Preview, approve and export the public view through normal and direct routes.
critical_scenarios.expected: Disclosure and rights checks withhold disallowed content; changed redactions require renewed review.

critical_scenarios.title: Report correction
critical_scenarios.fixture: A report was issued to two recipients and later corrected, with one recipient currently unable to receive email.
critical_scenarios.action: Open the old verification link and dispatch correction notifications.
critical_scenarios.expected: Old status is superseded with successor link; delivery failure remains recorded and escalated appropriately.

critical_scenarios.title: Model recall
critical_scenarios.fixture: A recalled component appears in several configurations and registered sites, including one stale version report.
critical_scenarios.action: Run impact discovery and issue required site actions.
critical_scenarios.expected: All registered dependent scopes appear, stale inventory is explicit and unresolved acknowledgements remain open.

critical_scenarios.title: Deletion with hold
critical_scenarios.fixture: A deletion request covers both held and unheld assets with a shorter local disposal deadline.
critical_scenarios.action: Approve the lawful scope and run disposal.
critical_scenarios.expected: Held assets remain preserved, unheld assets meet applicable deadline and attestation lists exact retained exceptions.

critical_scenarios.title: Restoration resurrection
critical_scenarios.fixture: A backup predates a user's revocation and a lawful data deletion.
critical_scenarios.action: Restore into isolation and attempt to reopen service before current ledger reconciliation.
critical_scenarios.expected: Reopening is blocked until current restrictions apply; departed user and disposed data remain inaccessible.

critical_scenarios.title: Duplicate webhook
critical_scenarios.fixture: One webhook representing a completed billable run is delivered five times and later replayed out of order.
critical_scenarios.action: Process all deliveries and reconcile resulting evidence and charge records.
critical_scenarios.expected: One logical outcome and declared charge exist; duplicate event receipts remain auditable without repeated effects.

critical_scenarios.title: Spending overrun
critical_scenarios.fixture: Two concurrent jobs approach a shared hard budget ceiling and one triggers retry.
critical_scenarios.action: Submit both and inspect reservations, metering and stop behaviour.
critical_scenarios.expected: No unauthorised overrun is committed; warnings, safe termination, retained evidence and charge reconciliation are correct.

critical_scenarios.title: Unsupported capability
critical_scenarios.fixture: A user selects an unsupported modality or a draft country profile while the UI capability flag is enabled.
critical_scenarios.action: Attempt admission, execution and formal issue through direct commands.
critical_scenarios.expected: Capability and country gates deny formal activity regardless of menu visibility.

critical_scenarios.title: Accessibility barrier
critical_scenarios.fixture: Representative keyboard and screen reader users complete onboarding and core workflows using the approved browser matrix.
critical_scenarios.action: Authenticate, resolve form errors, review a record, confirm an action and file an incident.
critical_scenarios.expected: Required actions are operable with labelled fields, focus handling and announcements; critical accessibility barriers block release.

critical_scenarios.title: Constrained connection
critical_scenarios.fixture: L1 workload is active over 1 Mbps, 300 ms round trip and one percent packet loss.
critical_scenarios.action: Save application, review task and file incident with representative content.
critical_scenarios.expected: Core metadata workflows meet eight seconds p95 without losing saved changes; large deliberate transfers are separately measured.

critical_scenarios.title: Regional disaster
critical_scenarios.fixture: A recoverable regional disaster occurs after timestamped decisions, grants, metadata and source data changes.
critical_scenarios.action: Execute the approved recovery plan in a permitted region and reconcile evidence before reopening.
critical_scenarios.expected: Four hour RTO and differentiated 5 minute, 15 minute and contracted source RPO targets are verified with actual loss measurements.

critical_scenarios.title: Ai provider outage
critical_scenarios.fixture: All optional AI providers are unavailable or disabled by the institution.
critical_scenarios.action: Draft manually, review evidence and report an incident.
critical_scenarios.expected: Authorised core workflows remain usable; assistant state shows unavailable without fabricated content or blocked safety intake.

critical_scenarios.title: Institutional exit
critical_scenarios.fixture: An institution exits with a shared dataset, active monitoring duty, retained report and open financial item.
critical_scenarios.action: Create export, revoke access, transfer owners and issue closure attestation.
critical_scenarios.expected: Only permitted assets transfer, monitoring responsibility is accepted, attribution remains and residual obligations stay assigned.

critical_scenarios.title: Clinical threshold misuse
critical_scenarios.fixture: An admitted task has no approved clinical threshold but a model scores highly on a generic benchmark.
critical_scenarios.action: Attempt protocol freeze, suitability decision and final issue using a global accuracy default.
critical_scenarios.expected: Each dependent decision remains blocked until a qualified task-specific rule is approved; favourable score provides no bypass.
